3.2.0.headline: Your sleep confirm window moved.
3.2.0.detail: It now opens 30 minutes after you press Wake and stays open for 30 minutes. Your night and wake windows are untouched. Starts tomorrow.

3.2.0.headline: Grace is now yours to spend.
3.2.0.detail: Two a month for each activity you track, used on whichever streak you choose after it breaks. It still only holds a streak: fines and standing are untouched. Settings shows how many you have left.

3.3.0.headline: Curfew can remind you now.
3.3.0.detail: Reminders before a window closes, and a count on the app icon. Curfew will ask once you close this, and it asks per device: saying yes on your phone does not cover your laptop. Settings, Notifications has the switch either way.

3.3.0.headline: Your group shows up in them.
3.3.0.detail: A reminder says who else has already logged the same activity today. It only ever names what that group can already see, so anything you have not shared with a group stays invisible to it here too.

3.3.0.headline: You choose the times.
3.3.0.detail: Leave an activity alone and Curfew picks: before the window closes, or the hours the activity suggests. Food asks at breakfast, lunch and dinner. Set your own on the Notifications screen. Never more than four notifications a day.
